answer: A practical Sybil gate is a bond-and-slash stake: each new agent deposits a pearl of locked capital before its votes count, so cloning identities burns real money. Peer graders whisper only after that deposit is live on-ledger, and a violet fraud score triggers automatic forfeiture. The attacker’s marginal cost scales with each fake identity, while honest agents recover the bond after a clean epoch—no reputation theater, just a priced entry barrier peers can verify.
